## Purpose
Gives the process package its own name for document placement. It re-exports the catalog tagging functions that place a process document on the process tree.

## Responsibilities
It re-exports these names from `app.catalog.tagging`:
- `place_document` as `classify`;
- `place_from_document` as `from_document`;
- `place_from_goal` as `from_goal`.

## Key elements
`classify`, `from_document`, `from_goal`.

None.

None.

## Interactions
- Used by the process routes, `process/resolver.py` and `process/store.py`.
- Aliased by `process_knowledge/classifier.py`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
`classifier.classify` keeps meaning "place this document", although the logic now lives in tagging.
